name: Den of the Orcish Raiders
description: The King's only daughter, Princess Elinore has been kidnapped by a band of bloodthirsty Orcs and they are now hiding out in an abandoned castle. The King has promised a reward of 500 gold coins to whoever returns her to him safely. Search the abandoned castle and free the Princess and put an end to the Orcs reign of terror.
